summary: Iteration 24 validated the Dashboard KPIs revamp end-to-end (backend + frontend). Backend: created /app/backend/tests/test_dashboard_kpis_v2.py with 13 tests, all pass — (a) counts.vencidas uses expiry_date and excludes concluido/executada/suspenso/cancelado plus projects without expiry_date (DASHKPI-01/02 listed, DASHKPI-03..06 correctly excluded despite past expiry, DASHKPI-09 without expiry_date NOT listed even though end_date is past); each vencida item exposes dias_vencida>=1 and expiry_date; counts.vencendo_amanha uses expiry_date == amanhã (DASHKPI-07). (b) carteira block returns apta/nao_apta/programadas/concluidas/total each with count/value/actual_value/pct_count/pct_value/statuses — sum of the 4 counts == total.count and pct_count sums to ~100 (partition covers every status). (c) financeiro.valor_faturado sums actual_value of billing_stage=pago (>=42.000 from DASHKPI-03), faturado_count>=1; valor_pendente_faturamento sums actual_value of concluído/executada with stage!=pago (>=78.000 from DASHKPI-10), pendente_count>=1; meta_mes defaults to 336000 when no contract_targets, receita_pct/pago_mes/pago_mes_count/receita_realizada_count all present. (d) tempo_medio.* is {avg, samples}, and with the DASHKPI-03 fully-populated seed all 4 windows have samples>=1 (recebimento_programacao samples=3, programacao_execucao=3, execucao_fechamento=2, fechamento_faturamento=1). (e) /api/analytics/manager-kpis regression still 200 with operational.overdue. Frontend (Playwright, admin real user): logged in with lucasc@..., Dashboard renders kpi-vencidas-card (2 vencidas), clicking opens vencidas-modal with 2 vencida-row-{id} entries showing 'Venceu em' (dd/mm/aaaa), 'há N dia(s)', valor + Abrir obra (vencida-open-{id}) and Ver na Carteira; vencidas-modal-close closes. kpi-carteira-row renders 4 cards apta/nao_apta/programadas/concluidas each with count, %das obras, R$ valor and %do valor (7/53.8%/R$361K, 2/15.4%/R$40K, 1/7.7%/R$60K, 3/23.1%/R$140K + Realizado R$139K). Clicking each navigates to /carteira?filter=apta|nao_apta|programadas|completed and carteira-drilldown-banner shows correct label + correct count (7/2/1/3, all match backend). /carteira?filter=vencidas shows 'Obras vencidas 2 obra(s)' matching counts.vencidas=2. kpi-financial-row shows Valor Faturado (Pago) R$42.000 '1 obra pagas · produção realizada' (clicks → /faturamento), Pendente Faturamento R$97.000 '2 concluídas ainda não pagas' (clicks → /faturamento?view=backlog), kpi-receita-mes 28.9% R$97.000 'meta contratual R$336.000,00 · 2 executadas no mês · Pago no mês R$42.000,00'. kpi-tempo-medio row renders all 4 tempo-medio-{key} cards with avg + 'n = X obra(s)' subtitle. No console errors during flow.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 5486 lines — the KPI aggregation (~1049-1234) is a good candidate for extraction into a dashboard_service module together with billing/movement helpers.

dashboard_kpis: the helper closures (status_of, prog, prod, exec_date, stage_entered, first_sched, days_between, avg) are redefined on every request. Consider hoisting them to module scope for readability and micro-perf.

dashboard_kpis: legacy projects with execution_status None fall into 'apta' bucket implicitly via status_of()'s default. This is documented in the request but a subtle behavior — consider explicitly documenting in a code comment near CARTEIRA_GROUPS.

CarteiraPage.drillDownLabel switch is duplicated with the CarteiraPage.filtered switch — extracting a single { key: { label, predicate } } map would avoid future drift (e.g. adding a new filter key in one place but forgetting the label).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression command: pytest backend/tests/test_dashboard_kpis_v2.py -v --tb=short (safe under xdist, no shared state — tests only READ /api/dashboard/kpis and /api/analytics/manager-kpis). Re-seed prerequisites: `cd /app/backend && python3 tests/seed_dashboard_kpis.py`. The 4 tempo_medio samples are ALL driven by DASHKPI-03; if the seed is not re-run before executing the pytest suite, TestTempoMedio.test_samples_positive_with_seed may fail if a prior test deleted DASHKPI-03. VencidasModal.jsx renders 'Venceu em' with CSS `uppercase` — Playwright inner_text() returns 'VENCEU EM'; use case-insensitive matching if asserting the label.
rca_of_the_issue: No bugs — full validation of the iter24 Dashboard revamp. Vencidas / Carteira / Financeiro / Tempo Médio all wired correctly from server.py dashboard_kpis → DashboardPage KPI rows → drill-down navigation into CarteiraPage/FaturamentoPage with matching counts.
